ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-level ratio is heavily weighted toward low-intensity (black) pixels, with high-intensity (white) pixels comprising less than 10% of the surface area, primarily found in localized scarring and barnacle clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity black field across the entire ventral surface; high-contrast white clusters are localized at the distal lateral tips of both lobes; scattered high-contrast linear marks are visible on the right lobe and near the peduncle.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with a measured pixel angle of approximately 85 degrees and a bounding-box depth occupying roughly 15% of the total vertical height of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serration pattern across the entire trailing edge; peaks are most prominent and jagged at the outer margins, transitioning to smoother, lower-frequency variations near the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge exhibits a consistent convex sweep from the median notch outward, terminating in sharp upward-curving distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of roughly circular high-contrast white pixels are present at the extreme lateral tips of the left and right lobes, corresponding to localized barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct, unaligned white linear rake marks are visible, particularly concentrated on the medial and lateral regions of the right lobe, intersecting at various angles.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake marks across the right lobe and central fluke surface; significant encrusting barnacle growth on the distal tips of both lobes.
